dialogue.content: こんにちは、本日よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Hello, thank you for coming in today.

dialogue.content: こんにちは。よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Hello. Thank you for meeting with me.

dialogue.content: 少し早いですが、はじめてもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: It's a bit early, but may we begin?

dialogue.content: はい、大丈夫です。よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Yes, that's fine. Thank you.

dialogue.content: それでははじめさせていただきますね。
dialogue.English: Alright, let's get started.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: こんにちは。相談員です。よろしくお願いいたします。本日はどのようなご相談でしょうか。
dialogue.English: Hello. I'm your counselor. It's nice to meet you. What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: はい。私は結婚当初から、義父が自分の荷物を全て私に持たせます。その理由が知りたいです。
dialogue.English: Yes. Ever since I got married, my father-in-law has had me carry all of his belongings. I would like to know why.

dialogue.content: そのようなことが続いているのですね。それはお悩みですね。
dialogue.English: I see that this has been ongoing. That must be troubling for you.

dialogue.content: そうなんです
dialogue.English: Yes, it is.

dialogue.content: どのようなシーンや状況で、義父さんは、相談者様に荷物を持たせるのでしょうか？具体的におしえていただけますか？
dialogue.English: In what kinds of situations does your father-in-law have you carry his belongings? Could you please tell me more specifically?

dialogue.content: いつも家族で外出する時は、息子である主人がいても、義母がいても、義妹がいても、絶対に持たせず、義父の荷物は、ペットボトル１つ持たずに全て私に渡します。
dialogue.English: Whenever we go out as a family, even if his son—my husband—is there, my mother-in-law, or my sister-in-law, he absolutely never lets them carry anything. He gives all of his belongings to me, without even carrying a single water bottle himself.

dialogue.content: ！！そうなんですね...それはどうしたら良いかわかりませんし、疲れてしまいますよね。
dialogue.English: Oh, I see... That must be so confusing and exhausting for you.

dialogue.content: 義父さんが、相談者様に荷物を渡す時に、義母さん、義理の妹さん、夫さんは何もおっしゃられないのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: When your father-in-law hands his belongings to you, do your mother-in-law, sister-in-law, or your husband say anything?

dialogue.content: 誰も何も言いません。若い頃は、私も元気だったし、当たり前なのかと思ってやってきましたが、近頃は少々辛くなってきました。
dialogue.English: No one says anything. When I was younger, I had the energy and thought it might just be expected, so I went along with it, but lately it has become a bit hard.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。。それはお辛いですよね...
dialogue.English: I see... That must be very hard for you...

dialogue.content: ご主人にはこのことを、ご相談されていますでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Have you discussed this with your husband?

dialogue.content: 主人は腰の持病があるので荷物を持つのは頼めないのですが、辛い気持ちはまだ打ち明けていません。
dialogue.English: My husband has a chronic back condition, so I can't ask him to carry things, but I haven't yet told him how hard this feels for me.

dialogue.content: ご相談もできずに我慢されてきたのですね。それは心苦しいですよね...
dialogue.English: So you've been enduring this without being able to talk to him. That must be painful...

dialogue.content: 荷物を持たせるといった行為以外で、ご相談者様と義父さん、義母さんとのご関係はこれまでいかがだったでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Aside from this behavior of making you carry belongings, how has your relationship with your father-in-law and mother-in-law been up until now?

dialogue.content: はい、辛いです。今さら主人に打ち明けるのが、何だか怖いような
dialogue.English: Yes, it's hard. Now, after all this time, I somehow feel scared to open up to my husband.

dialogue.content: 怖いとまでお感じなほど、ずっと打ち明けられなかったのですね...
dialogue.English: You've felt so scared that you haven't been able to open up all this time...

dialogue.content: はい、そうなんです
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: 先ほどの質問ですが、荷物を持たせるといった行為以外で、ご相談者様と義父さん、義母さんとのご関係はこれまでいかがだったでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Returning to my earlier question: aside from the behavior of making you carry belongings, how has your relationship with your father-in-law and mother-in-law been up until now?

dialogue.content: 嫁だからということで、私に任せることは多かったと思います。義父、義母、義妹、主人、対、私という関係で、本心を相談する人がいなくて、我慢してきたんだと思います。
dialogue.English: Because I'm the daughter-in-law, I think many things were left to me. It's been a dynamic of my father-in-law, mother-in-law, sister-in-law, and husband versus me. I've had no one to confide my true feelings in, so I think I've just been enduring it.

dialogue.content: それは、本当にお辛いですね...そのような関係のまま、誰にも相談できず、ずっと我慢されてこられたのですね。
dialogue.English: That must be truly difficult... You've been enduring all this time in that kind of relationship, without being able to consult anyone.

dialogue.content: はい、主人は、両親には逆らえない人ですから、相談するのは勇気がいります。
dialogue.English: Yes. My husband can't stand up to his parents, so it takes courage for me to talk to him about it.

dialogue.content: 義父、義母、義妹、主人とご家族、対、ご相談者という関係であるということでしたが、義理の妹さんも夫さんはご両親との仲はいかがでしょうか？会話などはされているのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: You mentioned the relationship is your family—your father-in-law, mother-in-law, sister-in-law, and husband—versus you. How is your sister-in-law and husband's relationship with their parents? Do they talk much?

dialogue.content: 余り会話はしていません。仲は良くないと思います。
dialogue.English: They don't talk much. I don't think they have a good relationship.

dialogue.content: ご主人がご両親に逆らえず良好ではないという状況では、ご相談しづらいですよね。。。本当によく我慢されてらっしゃいますね。
dialogue.English: In a situation where your husband can't oppose his parents and their relationship isn't good, it must be hard to consult him... You've really been enduring a lot.

dialogue.content: 少しこれまでの話まとめさせていただいてもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Would it be alright if I summarized what we've talked about so far?

dialogue.content: これまでは元気だったので、なんとかやってきましたが、、、
dialogue.English: I had the energy until now to get by somehow, but...

dialogue.content: はい、
dialogue.English: Yes,

dialogue.content: お願いします
dialogue.English: Please do.

dialogue.content: 結婚してからずっと義父が、自分の荷物を全て私に持たせる状況が続いている。若い頃は良かったが、辛くなってきている。
dialogue.English: Since you married, your father-in-law has continued to have you carry all of his belongings. It was manageable when you were younger, but it has become difficult.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 夫にも打ち明けられないでずっと我慢されていた。義父、義母、義妹、主人、対、ご相談者様という関係で、本心を相談できる人がいないまま我慢をされてきたのですね。
dialogue.English: And you've been enduring it all this time without being able to confide in your husband. You've been putting up with it in a situation where it's your father-in-law, mother-in-law, sister-in-law, and husband versus you, with no one to share your true feelings with.

dialogue.content: はい、そうなんです
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: 我慢強く、義理のご家族にもお優しいご相談者様、ご結婚されてからずっとがんばってこられたのだと思います。
dialogue.English: You are very patient and kind to your in-laws. I imagine you've been trying so hard ever since you got married.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 一方で、体力的にもお辛くなってきて、荷物を持つのも、我慢するのもとてもしんどくなってしまっているように感じました。
dialogue.English: On the other hand, it seems it has become physically difficult, and both carrying the bags and enduring the situation have become very taxing for you.

dialogue.content: はい、そうです
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: ぜひこれからのこと、一緒に考えていければと思います。
dialogue.English: I'd like for us to think together about what to do going forward.

dialogue.content: これからご自身で、義父や夫さんとの関係、どのようにされたいと思いますか。
dialogue.English: Going forward, how would you yourself like to handle your relationships with your father-in-law and your husband?

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: まずは夫に気持ちを伝え、私の気持ちを分かってもらいたいと思っていますが、どんな風に伝えればよいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: First, I'd like to tell my husband how I feel and have him understand my feelings, but how should I go about telling him?

dialogue.content: そうですよね。まずは義父の息子である夫さんと、ご相談者様がしっかりと会話をすることが大切ですよね。
dialogue.English: I agree. First and foremost, it's important for you to have a proper conversation with your husband, who is your father-in-law's son.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ご主人様とは、ご結婚されて長い年月一緒におられると思いますが、義父のこと以外では、気軽にお話しされたりできるのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: You and your husband have been married for many years, I believe. Aside from matters concerning your father-in-law, are you able to talk with him casually?

dialogue.content: そうですね。主人は、寡黙な人で私の話は聞いてくれますが、本人は自分のことをあまり話さないので、何を考えているのか分かりづらい感じです。
dialogue.English: Well... My husband is a quiet man. He listens to what I have to say, but he doesn't talk much about himself, so it's hard to know what he's thinking.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。義父の荷物を持つことを拒めない辛さの奥には、まず長年一緒にいらっしゃる夫さんにも、本心が言えないことがお辛いように思いましたが、いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. It seems that behind the difficulty of not being able to refuse to carry your father-in-law's belongings, there is also the pain of not being able to tell your husband, whom you've been with for many years, your true feelings. How does that resonate with you?

dialogue.content: そうですね。その通りだと思います。
dialogue.English: Yes. I think that's exactly right.

dialogue.content: よく我慢されきたと思います。まずは夫さんとの関係をよりよくするためにも、ご相談者様ご本人が、少しでも好きなことをされたり、ご自身を大切にされることをぜひお勧めします。
dialogue.English: You've endured so much. To start, in order to improve your relationship with your husband, I'd like to recommend that you do things you enjoy, even small ones, and take good care of yourself.

dialogue.content: どんな風にしたらいいですか？
dialogue.English: What kind of things should I do?

dialogue.content: ２つほどご提案があります。1つは,義父から荷物をもたされたなどご自身が嫌なことがあった時に、それをしっかりノートなどに記録して、ため込まないことが大切かと思います。
dialogue.English: I have a couple of suggestions. One is, when something unpleasant happens, like your father-in-law making you carry his bags, it might be important to write it down in a notebook or somewhere, so you don't keep it all bottled up.

dialogue.content: はい、分かりました。やってみます。
dialogue.English: Okay, I understand. I'll give it a try.

dialogue.content: もう1つは、お一人で好きな趣味やショッピングなどご自身だけのために、時間をつくることができればと思いました。ずっとできなかった習い事や行きたかった旅行の計画などでもいいと思います。
dialogue.English: Another is to make time just for yourself, for a hobby you enjoy or for shopping. It could even be starting a class you've always wanted to take, or planning a trip you've always wanted to go on.

dialogue.content: はい、楽しそうですね。考えてみます。
dialogue.English: Yes, that sounds fun. I'll think about it.

dialogue.content: 今まで我慢されていたことがたくさんあると思いますので、今日から自分のためのエネルギーとして、使っていただきたいと思いました。
dialogue.English: I imagine there are many things you've been putting up with, so I was hoping that starting today, you could use that energy for yourself.

dialogue.content: いきなり行動に移すのは難しそうですが、それならできそうです。
dialogue.English: It seems hard to take action all at once, but that sounds doable.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。いきなりすごいことをしなくても少しずつでも、ご自身のケアをぜひしてあげてほしいと思いました。
dialogue.English: I understand. You don't have to do anything drastic all at once. I just hope you can start taking care of yourself, even little by little.

dialogue.content: 少し気持ちが軽くなりました。
dialogue.English: I feel a little lighter.

dialogue.content: ご相談者様が、前向きに人生を過ごすために、ぜひ時間もエネルギーもご自身のために使うことができればと思います。
dialogue.English: I hope you can use your time and energy for yourself, so that you can live your life more positively.

dialogue.content: そうですね。
dialogue.English: You're right.

dialogue.content: 余裕や自信ができることで、ご主人や義理のご家族とも、対等な関係が築けるようになるのではないかと思います。
dialogue.English: By gaining more emotional space and confidence, I believe you might be able to build a more equal relationship with your husband and your in-laws.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 長年変わらない関係で、荷物を持たされたり我慢することが当たり前だったと思いますので、ぜひご自身に自信を持っていただきたいと思いました。
dialogue.English: In a relationship that hasn't changed for years, I'm sure carrying the bags and enduring things has become the norm, so I really want you to build your self-confidence.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: すぐに解決する話ではないかと思いますので、またお辛くなったらぜひ、いつでもご相談にきていただけたらと思います。本日はそろそろお時間ですが、いかがだったでしょうか？
dialogue.English: This may not be something that resolves quickly, so if it becomes difficult again, please feel free to come back and talk with me anytime. We're nearly out of time for today—how was this session for you?

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。これからやれることが見つかって、少し気持ちが楽になりました。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you. I've found some things I can work on, and I feel a bit more at ease. Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: 心からご相談者様が我慢せず、自信を持って過ごせることを陰ながら応援しています。
dialogue.English: From the bottom of my heart, I'm quietly rooting for you to live with confidence and without having to hold back.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: ではここでカウンセリングを終了させていただきます。またいつでもいらしてください。本日はありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Then we'll conclude our counseling session here. Please feel free to come back anytime. Thank you for your time today.

dialogue.content: (ありがとうございました)
dialogue.English: (Thank you very much.)

dialogue.content: （どうもありがとうございました）
dialogue.English: (Thank you very much.)
